The '''''Hell's Axe''''' was a modified [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [["Explorer" Scout Ship]] owned by [[Kin Laron]]. The ''Hell's Axe'' was extensively modified by Kin to have drastically superior [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed, maneuverability, [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], and weapon systems from the ships stock model. Additionally, the ship featured an enlarged [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] which could accommodate Kin's [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|space trooper]] armor, as well as an section of converted cargo space turned into an arsenal compartment.
